lessons_used: Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several unexpected winning updates performed better than predicted.

Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path hint, choose_path new_flow, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) were helpful, winning in 6 of 10 tests (+9.4%, +5.6%, +4.3%, +4.4%, +3.1%, and +2.4%), while 4 showed no clear effect.
Sign-in wait info (sign_in wait_info) updates were consistently helpful, winning in both tests (+3.0% and +7.3%).
Home wait info (home wait_info) changes were helpful in 4 of 12 tests (+4.2%, +4.0%, +2.6%, and +2.7%), while the remaining 8 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign and sign-in reordering (sign_in reorder) consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests each.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Speech & Chat Simulation Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive dialogue simulation flow on the home intro screen that allows users to test sending messages and receiving responses from their desktop pet before finishing setup.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple tickets from users confused about how to talk to or interact with their pet after onboarding. Finish interactive flows have won in 6 out of 10 prior tests.

home_intro.headline: Practice Chatting With Your Companion
home_intro.body: Type a message or press speech to test your pet's desktop response features right now.

components.text: Try saying hello or typing a command to your pet.

guard.reason: Valid addition to home_intro onboarding screen.

candidates.score_note: Interactive finish flows have a high historical win rate (6/10 tests, +2.9% average lift), though finish step already has high baseline conversion.

candidates.title: Cloud Sync and Multi-Session Account Restore Status Info
candidates.change: Display a sign-in sync status banner clarifying that logging in preserves existing pets and prevents account resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again. Sign-in wait info updates have consistently won in previous tests (+3.0% and +7.3%).

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your companion data across restarts and devices.

guard.reason: Valid sync status hint on sign_in step.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between support tickets (8 emails) and proven sign_in wait_info pattern (+5.2% avg relative gain). Low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Summon & Dismiss Practice Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen named new_summon_practice before home_intro where users practice hiding and summoning their companion with keyboard shortcuts.
candidates.why: Support mail showed 3 complaints about being unable to control or hide pets on the desktop. Interactive finish flows have a high win rate (+9.4%, +5.6%).

new_summon_practice.headline: Practice Summoning & Hiding Your Pet
new_summon_practice.body: Try pressing the shortcut key to toggle your desktop companion visibility.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Account Session Verification & Recovery Wait Status Display
candidates.change: Display a real-time account verification status indicator on the sign-in step to inform users that credential verification is actively running.
candidates.why: 2 support tickets noted that the sign-in screen stalled or failed to appear. Sign-in wait info changes have proven consistently effective in tests.

sign_in.headline: Verifying Account & Securing Companion
sign_in.hint: Checking cloud authentication and restoring saved pet profiles...

guard.reason: Valid account verification status display on sign_in step.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in wait info updates consistently perform well across tests, supporting user confidence during credentials verification.

candidates.title: Desktop Overlay and Screen Layering Readiness Status Monitor
candidates.change: Show a desktop rendering layer and screen placement readiness status monitor during the waiting step.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show up on desktop upon launch. Home wait info changes have successfully improved conversion in 4 previous tests.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Layer & Pet Rendering
waiting.hint: Verifying desktop window transparency, layering, and display bounds...

guard.reason: Valid rendering readiness status monitor added to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home step conversion is already high (94.2%), and home wait_info changes show mixed historical results (4/12 wins).

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Behavior & Mood Adjustment Guided Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive behavior tuning widget on home_intro allowing users to set pet idle actions and desktop activity preferences before launching.
candidates.why: 4 support emails cited desktop feature misbehavior after setup. Adding an interactive finish flow allows users to configure behavior upfront.

home_intro.headline: Set Companion Desktop Behavior
home_intro.body: Choose how active your pet should be while you work on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid behavior mode adjustment widget added to home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Interactive finish flow pattern is effective (+2.9% avg), but developing a new tuning widget requires new screen development.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Pose & Framing Quality Preparation Hint
candidates.change: Add a photo preparation quality hint on the photo upload screen explaining optimal framing and lighting for custom pet creation.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results, contributing to low conversion (72.3%) at the adoption step.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit photos with your pet centered for best rendering quality.

guard.reason: Valid quality preparation hint added to upload_photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has the highest user drop-off (72.3% conversion). Hints have moderate historic gains (+0.9%) at minimal effort.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Control Bar Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen using a card layout featuring direct interactive control action buttons for hiding, moving, and talking to the pet.
candidates.why: Users reported confusion post-onboarding on how to interact with their pets. Finish screen redesign with card structure highlights essential controls.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Review essential desktop controls and quick action shortcuts below.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of home_intro screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns carry high risk of performance degradation across historical tests and require a full release.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Path Capability Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Include a helpful guidance hint on choose_path clarifying what each companion path offers before selection.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a high mean duration (514s), suggesting users hesitate when choosing a path. Providing clear guidance reduces friction.

choose_path.hint: Select standard companion for immediate setup or custom path to build your own pet.

guard.reason: Valid guidance hint added to choose_path screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long step duration, but choose_path hints previously showed no positive impact (-0.2% in prior test).

candidates.title: Custom Pet Render Diagnostic Verification Status Info
candidates.change: Add real-time render diagnostic verification status indicators on the adoption certificate screen while asset details populate.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest step conversion rate in the onboarding funnel (72.3%). Displaying active status info keeps users engaged during generation.

adoption_certificate.hint: Verifying pet traits and generating official adoption seal...

guard.reason: Valid verification status indicator added to adoption_certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets the biggest funnel bottleneck (adoption 72.3%) with a pattern that delivered +3.7% in prior tests.
